_comment: Every markdown file under docs/, plus the always-loaded map, is listed here. `budgets` carries the standing documents and their word ceilings: verify-doc-budgets.sh fails a file over its ceiling, and fails a file under 85 percent of it so that deleting words lowers the ceiling in the same commit. A new ceiling is the word count plus 5 percent. Raising one is a deliberate edit, justified in the pull request. `frozen` carries the measurement records, which have no ceiling because they are not guidance and are not edited. A file in neither list fails the script, so a new document cannot be the way out of a budget.
